operations.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production source components for the same animated sticker, NOT a finished scene. Create ONE tall transparent PNG arranged as EIGHT isolated components in TWO columns and FOUR rows, equal square cells, no text, labels, borders or dividers. Images1 and2 show the exact existing cream-and-turquoise small mouse character in purple imp hood with TWO cloth horns, navy/purple cape and round amber-gold clasp, playing with a magenta jack-in-the-box. Image3 is the identity reference for exactly TWO small upper central front teeth: no side teeth or bottom teeth. Preserve polished soft 3D sticker style, same color and friendly character identity. Generous transparent margins within every cell. ROW1 LEFT: entire full-body character wearing the purple two-horn hood/cape from Image1, playful mischievous grin with exactly TWO front teeth and one playful wink, both feet planted. Remove BOTH arms and paws, fill the small cape/torso regions behind them naturally, no detached stumps, armless underlying body animation plate. No box or props in this cell. ROW1 RIGHT: ONLY one isolated LEFT arm from shoulder to gently curved gripping paw, cream fur with turquoise tips, forearm angled down-right, no body. ROW2 LEFT: ONLY one isolated RIGHT arm from shoulder to gently curved gripping paw, forearm angled down-left, matching fur and shading, no body. ROW2 RIGHT: ONLY the magenta gift BOX BASE from Image2, open top dark interior, visible front and right side in the same three-quarter perspective, vertical gold ribbon bands; absolutely NO lid, bow, spring, star or hands. ROW3 LEFT: ONLY the matching CLOSED LID TOP with magenta bow and gold ribbon, in the three-quarter nearly horizontal perspective matching the box opening; no box base. ROW3 RIGHT: ONLY the matching lid UNDERSIDE, plain dark-magenta interior with a clean raised rim, same basic flat lid geometry seen from its inside, NO bow on the underside, no box. ROW4 LEFT: ONLY an upright silver metal coil spring with FIVE distinct clean turns, full spring unobstructed and isolated, no star or box, no hands. ROW4 RIGHT: ONLY one rounded small gold five-point star as seen on the spring in Image2, full star unobstructed and isolated, no face, spring, hands or box. Components must never touch another cell or be joined together. True transparent background outside each isolated component. Match the same lighting and perspective across all pieces. The objects will be rigged and layered; complete clean silhouettes and no extra limbs/teeth/props are essential.

Edit this exact eight-component animation atlas. Change ONLY the background and the background glow. Remove the entire colored/gray backdrop, every surrounding glow and every cast shadow outside the eight object silhouettes. Produce a REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, not black, not a gradient, not checkerboard artwork. Preserve all eight objects exactly in their current positions and proportions: full armless purple-hood mouse character at top-left, two isolated arms, open magenta box base, lid top with bow, lid underside, silver spring, gold star. Preserve their own textures and shading inside the silhouettes. Keep the two small front teeth, wink and all object details. Do not change, move, merge, cut off, duplicate or add an object. No labels or lines. This is a clean source-component cutout with no background pixels between the objects.
